assumptions: Headless Chrome on an M1 Pro caps rAF at 60 Hz so p95 16.7 ms is vsync-bound; render CPU p95 0.8 ms is the headroom signal.
Cold-load gain and toe-into-prop corners were not re-measured; nothing visibly worse was seen.
Skills Workshop and tower reached by closed-loop scripted steering, not a human.
lessonsProposed: FINDING F1 (low, owner game-dev): entry world fade first step is 10.5 luminance (3.75x neighbour median) vs the previously accepted 6.8-7.0 (2.27x); by eye still a monotone fade from dark over about 10 frames, not a pop. Not blocking.

FINDING F2 (low, owner game-dev): leaving the tower passage and jumping at its mouth, the camera sits 2.2 m away and the avatar head is cropped off the top for about two frames (portrait and landscape; the f4 desktop scenarios show no geometry occlusion). No clipping or occlusion, follow-up framing polish only.

FINDING F3 (info, owner game-dev): post-GC heap creeps 17.19 to 19.04 MB over 50 cycles, increments shrinking to about 0.013 MB per cycle; listeners, nodes, geometries, textures, programs exactly constant; accepted as a plateau, carried M5 F2 closed.
FINDING F4 (info, owner game-dev, pending): stale HARD_MIN comment at components/game/followCamera.ts:310 (round-2 cross-review minor) is still present; comment-only fix before the PR.
